A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 36-page paper, including Appendices A–E. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish identical substantive content; the visible difference is the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v2 reports theoretical results, constructions, and proofs, including in its appendices. The reproducibility statement explicitly says all results are theoretical, and Section 4 leaves targeted empirical experiments to future work.

after.justification: v3 retains the same theoretical content and reproducibility statement. Neither the main text nor the appendices report original empirical outcomes; empirical findings discussed are attributed to prior work.

M1.justification: The planner–predictor formulation, resampling procedure, and transformer constructions are identical, including Section 2.2 and Appendix B.7.

E1.justification: Neither version reports datasets or tasks actually used for empirical training or evaluation. The theoretical treatment of formal-language recognition and other reasoning problems is unchanged.

E2.justification: CoT, parallel CoT, and padded looped transformers remain the same theoretical comparison frameworks. Neither version reports empirically evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Neither version reports experimental evaluation protocols. No empirical splits, metrics, training budgets, sample sizes, or testing procedures are added or revised.

E4.justification: No ablation, sensitivity, robustness, or error-analysis experiments appear in either version. The illustrative examples and supplementary theoretical analyses are unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental run counts, seeds, error bars, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Reported findings and numerical illustrations are identical. Figure 3 retains three parallel unmasking steps versus eleven sequential CoT steps; neither version reports empirical performance scores.

T1.justification: Definitions, assumptions, theorem statements, derivations, and proofs are identical throughout Sections 2–3 and Appendices B–E.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about MDM–PLT equivalence, CoT simulation, and the efficiency separation for parallelizable reasoning.

C2.justification: Section 4 and Appendix C retain the same interpretations and qualifications concerning parallelism, positional encodings, planner idealizations, learnability, and future empirical validation.

D1.justification: Formal construction details and the reproducibility statement are unchanged. No implementation instructions, hyperparameters, hardware information, or code/data access information change.

R1.justification: The citations, bibliography, and positioning relative to prior research are identical, including the related-work discussion in Appendix A.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v2 dated 2 March 2026 to v3 dated 26 April 2026. This is a limited identification-text edit; prose, terminology, headings, and organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–3, captions, equation placement, and page layout are unchanged. Rendered differences are confined to the version/date text in the first-page margin stamp.

improvement.justification: v3 preserves the same scientific arguments, proofs, interpretations, and presentation, including all appendices. The version/date stamp update provides no meaningful improvement or deterioration in the paper's quality.
